name: Ruido de patron del sensor (PRNU)
description: Detecta la No-Uniformidad de Respuesta Fotografica, una huella unica dejada por cada sensor de camara.
algorithm: No Uniformidad de Respuesta Fotónica (PRNU) Sensor Noise Fingerprint
mechanism: Extrae unique sensor noise fingerprint from the image. Every camera sensor has unique fixed-patrón noise. generado por IA images lack any authentic PRNU patrón.
parameters: Denoising: BM3D / wavelet, Correlation: normalized cross-correlación, Umbral: Neyman-Pearson
accuracy: Baja en navegador - 55-65% sin sensor de referencia
source: Lukas et al. (2006), SPIE Image and Video Communications
useCase: Detecting absence of physical sensor noise fingerprint in generado por IA images

references.title: Lukas, J. et al. (2006). Digital Camera Identification from Sensor Pattern Noise. IEEE TIFS.
Chen, M. et al. (2008). Determining Image Origin and Integrity Using Sensor Noise. IEEE TIFS.
Goljan, M. et al. (2009). Large Scale Test of Sensor Fingerprint Camera Identification. SPIE.

strengths:
• Based on unique hardware sensor property
• Extremely difficult to forge sensor noise
• Well-established forense standard
• Can identify specific camera unit
limitations:
• Browser implementation has reduced precisión
• Requires reference sensor fingerprint for best results
• Heavy processing/compression destroys PRNU
• Large flat images provide better estimates
